caption: The drawing depicts the bust of a man in a military uniform, shown from the chest up and facing slightly to the left. The man's hair is dark brown and combed back. His facial expression is stern, with visible lines on his forehead and under his eyes. He is wearing a dark blue military coat with yellow trim and gold buttons arranged in two vertical rows along the chest. Epaulets with gold fringe are on both shoulders. Draped across his chest is a broad white sash, fastened at the right side by a large, round, gold and red medal or buckle. Attached to this sash is a detailed, gold ornamental object. Two blue flags with white stars and gold finials are visible behind his shoulders, one on each side. The background of the drawing is plain and uncolored, providing no contextual details. The colors in the composition primarily include shades of blue, gold, white, and brown.
title: Ship's Figurehead
